cause.what_happened: VBIO gapped down 8.9% at the 2026-09-28 open and added only -0.8% intraday, on 1.19x normal volume. This came one session after a -12.9% fall on 2026-09-25, and it gives back a roughly 43% five-day spike off the 2026-09-16 all-time low. No release or filing was dated today: the latest 8-K is the 2026-09-23 interim-CEO appointment, and the latest Form 4s (2026-09-24) are RSU awards and settlements.

Nasdaq bid-price compliance regained, announced 2026-09-22, which is the start of the spike the stock is now giving back

The 2026-08-31 3i deal: Series C preferred (7,637 shares) plus warrants on 1,053,969 shares at $3.62; $6.137m of the $7.737m price was retained by 3i for overdue true-up payments, so the company received only $1.5m

pipeline.next_dated_event: The resale registration statement for the 3i conversion and warrant shares is due no later than 2026-09-30 (30 days after the 2026-08-31 closing, per the 2026-09-01 8-K). It may be filed on 2026-09-29, inside the window.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An S-1 or S-3 resale filing on 2026-09-29 registering a share count that dwarfs the roughly 1.3m float would push this further negative. A filing dated 2026-09-30 or later, or a dated AFRRI/NIAID Entolimod GI-study readout, would pull it toward zero or positive.

positioning_check: Nasdaq/FINRA short interest was 38,427 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, 1.0 days to cover, down 88.7% from 340,186 on 2026-08-31 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/VBIO/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). Settlements publish about 8 business days late, so the position carried into the 09-25/09-28 falls cannot be seen. Float context: 1,285,626 shares were outstanding as of 2026-08-24 post-split, per 3i's 13D/A No. 7, which shows 3i at 9.9% under a 9.99% blocker (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1787740/000175392626001719/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml). There is no options market, so there is no skew.

findings.finding: Valion is contractually bound to file a resale registration statement covering 3i's Series B/C conversion shares and the 1,053,969 Series C warrant shares no later than 2026-09-30. Nothing is on EDGAR yet, so a filing on 2026-09-29 would land inside the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The filing deadline is 30 days after the 2026-08-31 closing, which is 2026-09-30. A filing accepted before 17:30 ET on 2026-09-29, or after 17:30 today and dated 09-29, is visible before the next close. I put roughly a one-in-three chance on it landing inside the window rather than on the deadline day or late.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name's prior supply events coincide with its worst sessions. The earlier S-1 was declared effective on 2026-08-12 (EFFECT form in the baseline filing list), and the stock fell -27.1% that day and -24.3% the next (baseline history). That is coincidence in dates, not a measured reaction to a resale filing.
findings.why_not_priced: The deal terms have been public since 09-01. What is not in the price is the physical document: an S-1 printing a registered share count probably larger than the whole ~1.3m float, which the retail holders of a $2.7 microcap mostly read from filing alerts, not from a 4-week-old 8-K. If the price already held it, the 09-01 filing would have marked the low. Instead the stock spiked about 43% in the five days to ~09-24, above levels where the $3.62 warrants look relevant.
findings.independence: Supporting context: 3i's 13D/A No. 7 shows it at the 9.99% blocker with more shares issuable on conversion and warrant exercise, i.e. a holder that sells to make room (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1787740/000175392626001719/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml). The timing itself has no second source.

outside_window.finding: The resale registration statement must be declared effective by 2026-10-30. Effectiveness is what actually frees 3i's conversion and warrant shares for sale; that is the bigger supply event, and it falls outside the window.
Data from the AFRRI/NIAID government-funded Entolimod shielded-mouse GI-injury study is described only as 'early fall', with no date. It is a positive binary with no clock.
The interim CEO's consulting agreement pays a bonus on the 'closing of a strategic transaction'. That is a stated sale or merger intent, with a term to 2027-01-22 and no date.
